reviewMethod: Root agent inspected every generated concept directly in image-generation tool output and the registered-plan image with view_image. Re-inspected the plan after the final data/label revision. Copies retain identical bytes.
viewsInspected: registered source plan before/after label and scarp-position revision

criteria.style: Consistent crisp anime shape language, irregular foliage, readable upright rock/wall faces.
criteria.playSpace: Visible connected clearings, broad routes and unobscured scale figure in sampled local concepts.
criteria.geography: Overview retains broad city, river, pond and regional relationships. Coordinate plan, not painting pixels, controls placement.
criteria.camera: 40-degree target informed composition. Generated camera geometry and lens footprint are illustrative, not measured or engine-validated.

faultsFoundAndResolved: F2/M2 codes were hidden by regional title labels; moved titles and inspected final plan.
Initial F1 scarp sat too far behind parts of the existing forest trail; brought candidate bands closer before rerendering.
implementationNotes: Ruins art shows decorative step-like paving; use a smooth heightfield ramp for the playable path.
Scale figure clothing and root-arch motifs do not relocate or redesign runtime characters/landmarks.
Master artwork softens the coastline and contains illustrative small rocks; source data and registered plan remain authoritative.
The full-world overview is intentionally near-overhead; local art targets the owner camera.
remainingLimits: Raster concept artwork only; no new 3D modules installed.
No measured camera projection, enemy telegraph occlusion test, device FPS or memory result.
